goal: Give every row of api.db_data_admin_scraped_source_inventory a canonical licensor_group_key/licensor_group_name (single 'unresolved' group for conflict/unresolved licensors), classify NBCU Product Submissions picker property rows as Submissions, and group the DB Data Admin Scraped Properties page by the canonical key.
prohibited_actions: No change to any object other than api.db_data_admin_scraped_source_inventory.
No grant widening beyond the original function's grants.
No change to licensor_key or row_key values.
No direct DDL on production outside the governed migration route.
No licensed row contents in public artifacts.
assumptions: plm.nbcu_property.source_kind exists with values property, franchise_asset, asset_metadata_label (129 picker rows and 120 asset_metadata_label rows at capture rank 1 on production).
stop_conditions: Stop if any unresolved or conflict licensor key would be assigned to a real licensor group.
Stop if the PR must edit the protected coordination source or business rules.
